title: Understanding Bias Calculation
text: To estimate the empirical bias, consider the formula for bias in the bias-variance decomposition: (E[f_theta(x)]-g(x))**2. Here, E[f_theta(x)] is the mean of the predictions, and g(x) is the true value. You need to find the difference between these two values and square it.

title: Identifying the True Value
text: The true value, g(x), is the actual measurement you are comparing your predictions against. In this context, it is the mean of the predictions minus the bias. Use the given statistics to help identify this value.
